description: State policy overview and exact program directory for subclass 190/491, with nomination places (allocation, used, remaining). Add occupation for program list matches and invitation records. program only filters briefs. Full policy is in get_state_nomination_detail; lists are in get_state_nomination_occupations. This public endpoint returns English natural-language text, preserving sources, conditions and pagination.

locale.description: Language of names/descriptions in the result: zh-CN (default, Simplified Chinese plus English names), en-US, zh-TW. Also selects the language prefix of returned oneuedu.com URLs.

occupation.description: Internal occupationCode from search_occupations, or occupation URL/slug. anzsco is a shared classification code, not a unique identity. Exact internal code matches take precedence; search to select a candidate only if no exact match exists.

program.description: Exact program name from a previous result (e.g. "TAS subclass 190 - Tasmanian Skilled Graduate (TSG)") to filter the brief program directory; use get_state_nomination_detail with programRules for full rules.

state.description: State or territory: ACT, NSW, NT, QLD, SA, TAS, VIC or WA. Omit for an all-states overview.

visaSubclass.description: Only programs for subclass 190 (Skilled Nominated) or 491 (Skilled Work Regional).

name: get_state_nomination
title: Get state nomination (190 / 491) programs
